failures.reason: By design: the sloppy fake agent sends its client assertions with the token endpoint as aud (reading S1 token-endpoint). 0.3 settled S1 and 0.4 keeps it: 4.1 makes the issuer the aud at every endpoint, so both mocks refuse its first token request with invalid_client and record client-assertion.aud. Its signed-in cells fail; its signed-out ones, which need no token request, pass.

Print with Poppy at ae453ed reads a Session JWT's delegation from pap_dlg and requires typ pap-delegation+jwt, names from earlier in the 0.3 draft. 0.4 5.2 names poppy_dlg and poppy-delegation+jwt, which our agent sends, so the store answers every signed-in or Session-header API request with 400 invalid_session. AS shows it as the expected insufficient_scope arriving as invalid_session.
